gorseller.istem: Extreme close-up of the head of a realistic European common green frog (smooth moist olive-green skin with dark spots and a pale green stripe along the back, big golden-bronze eyes with horizontal oval pupils, wide mouth) half-submerged in water on a wet stone, its bulging eyes pulled down into the head so that the eyeballs are sunken level with the skin and covered by a thin pale-green eyelid, the throat swelling, drops of water on the skin, dramatic rim light, dark blue-green background. The animal's face sits in the upper middle part of the frame, with calm empty space in the lower third.
gorseller.not: Kurbağa başı: gözler içeri çekilmiş, deriyle aynı hizada, ince göz kapağıyla örtülü; boğaz şişmiş. Ayak görünmez.
